014package org.microbean.bean;
015
016/**
017 * A {@link Cloneable} reigstry of {@link AutoCloseable} instances that itself is {@link AutoCloseable}.
018 *
019 * <p>{@linkplain #close() Closing} an {@link AutoCloseableRegistry} {@linkplain AutoCloseable#close() closes} its
020 * registrants.</p>
021 *
022 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson/" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
023 *
024 * @see #register(AutoCloseable)
025 */
026public interface AutoCloseableRegistry extends AutoCloseable {
027
028  /**
029   * Returns a new {@link AutoCloseableRegistry} instance that is not closed and has no {@linkplain
030   * #register(AutoCloseable)} registrations, that is logically a child of this {@link AutoCloseableRegistry} instance.
031   *
032   * <p>The new child instance will be {@linkplain #register(AutoCloseable) registered} with this {@link
033   * AutoCloseableRegistry} if this {@link AutoCloseableRegistry} is not closed, for subsequent closing when this {@link
034   * AutoCloseableRegistry} is {@linkplain #close() closed}.</p>
035   *
036   * @return a new {@link AutoCloseableRegistry} that is a child of this one
037   *
038   * @nullability Implementations of this method must not return {@code null}.
039   *
040   * @idempotency All invocations of implementations of this method must return new, distinct {@link AutoCloseable}
041   * instances.
042   *
043   * @threadsafety Implementations of this method must be safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.
044   *
045   * @see Cloneable
046   *
047   * @see #register(AutoCloseable)
048   */
049  public AutoCloseableRegistry newChild();
050
051  /**
052   * Closes this {@link AutoCloseableRegistry} and {@linkplain AutoCloseable#close() closes} its {@linkplain
053   * #register(AutoCloseable) registrants}.
054   *
055   * @idempotency Implementations of this method must be idempotent.
056   *
057   * @threadsafety Implementations of this method must be safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.
058   */
059  @Override // AutoCloseable
060  public void close();
061
062  /**
063   * If this {@link AutoCloseableRegistry} is not closed, and if the supplied {@link AutoCloseable} has not yet been
064   * registered, registers it such that it will be {@linkplain AutoCloseable#close() closed} when this {@link
065   * AutoCloseableRegistry} is {@linkplain #close() closed}, and returns {@code true}.
066   *
067   * <p>This method takes no action and returns {@code false} in all other cases.</p>
068   *
069   * @param c the {@link AutoCloseable} to register; must not be {@code null}
070   *
071   * @return {@code true} if and only if this {@link AutoCloseableRegistry} is not closed and the supplied {@link
072   * AutoCloseable} is not already registered and registration completed successfully; {@code false} in all other cases
073   *
074   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code c} is {@code null}
075   */
076  public boolean register(final AutoCloseable c);
077
078}
